items.title: Eddie Summers Interview, 1963-11-11
items.q: That was Bill Batt, that was, uh, Willie, Willie Baptiste jumpin' the paw on there back on there back in the way.

ctx.x: Yeah. We was playin' at that hall back there in Clayborne, and they hit that fella with the white sweater on.

That's another dance we had, man. We playin' back that hall back there in Egania, eh? Egania in Clayborne. Egania in Clayborne. And they say, hit that fella with that white goose neck sweater on, you know. And, uh, hit that fella with the white goose neck sweater, you know. Who had the goose neck sweater on? Keith Sheik. Keith Sheik had the goose neck sweater on. And they hit him, and knock him down, and half the while he heard something jumpin' a paw on there back in the way. That was Bill Batt, that was, uh,…

Boy. Friday night. Sonia. Yeah, it's hard to live to call Sonia. Sonia. So that most of the end, you know, wind it up with something. Huh? You get most of the end, you know, wind it up with something. Oh, well, I guess we must about covered everything, you know, because I got a lot from Eddie, with you that thing. And that uniform, huh? Yeah, he got that uniform. Texas jacket. I'm never going to untight you. I'm not going to untight you. I'm not going to untight you. I'm not going to believe that. Shed over his…
